race.comment: AMPLIFY (3) profiles strong for this after only missing by a neck in the G3 Colin Stephen Quality at Rosehill after being bumped at the start. Her fourth in the G3 Newcastle Cup two runs ago also reads well. Only needs to hold her form to prove hard to beat. CHILLAXING (6) has the most appealing local profile, with a strong record at this track and proven 2400m form. DIAMOND SHOW (10) is airborne but was ultimately left with too much ground to bridge last time in the Toowoomba. Doubt the rise in trip will bother her and she gets in at a featherweight again. Watch for her charging late. FELIX THE SCAT (4) was runner-up in the Cup after covering ground early. Thompson sticking is an obvious bonus, so respecting. TAPILDOODLEDO (8) is going better than his form reads but is drawn awful. With a bit of luck he could cause a scare at a big price.
